Want to try the 1980s AI photo trend yourself?

Upload a clear photo to ChatGPT and paste this:

Using my uploaded photo, show me what I would have looked like around 1985.

Preserve my identity, facial features, skin tone, age, and recognizable appearance.

Reimagine my hair, clothing, accessories, and surroundings with unmistakably mid-1980s styling — expressive silhouettes, statement accessories, layered details, distinctive colors, and period-appropriate textures.

Make the environment look authentic to 1985 with no modern objects or technology visible.

Make the final image feel like a genuine photograph taken in 1985 using analog film: natural film grain, slightly faded colors, subtle softness, direct flash, minor photographic imperfections, and a period-accurate red-orange date stamp in the lower corner.

Keep the pose and overall identity recognizable while changing the styling and environment naturally.

No modern text, objects, clothing, or accessories.

Save this for later and follow @buildwith_pankaj for practical AI content for professionals.

#ChatGPT #AIPrompt #AIPhotos #AITools #BuildWithPankaj
